cat > /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/msg36.txt <<'EOF'
fix(streams): unregistering file:// now stops the whole bare-path surface, not just fopen

php locates a wrapper for EVERY path, and a bare one resolves to the plain-files wrapper — so
`stream_wrapper_unregister("file")` stops eighteen operations. elephc stopped one, and only after
the previous commit fixed the bit it tested.

MEASURED, twenty-two operations one by one on `php -n` 8.5.6: `fopen`, `file_get_contents`,
`file`, `readfile`, `file_put_contents`, `file_exists`, `is_file`, `is_dir`, `is_readable`,
`filesize`, `filemtime`, `stat`, `unlink`, `rename`, `copy`, `mkdir`, `rmdir`, `opendir`,
`scandir` and `touch` all answer false while it is unregistered. `realpath()` and `glob()` do NOT,
because neither goes through a stream wrapper — and that half is as much of the property as the
other, so the test names them too: a guard added there would be a divergence in the other
direction.

Before: 3 of 22 agreed. Now: 22 of 22.

ONE SHARED EMITTER, not eighteen copies of a mask test. The bit had already drifted once — a
literal that stopped agreeing with `STREAM_WRAPPERS` left the `fopen` guard testing `https` — and
eighteen hand-written copies would be eighteen chances to do it again.

THE REFUSAL HAS THREE SHAPES, and using one for all of them is what the work actually turned on:

  - a PREDICATE answers in x0/rax alone;
  - the `int|false` helpers answer a PAIR, value plus a SUCCESS FLAG the caller's boxer reads —
    setting only the value left `filemtime` reporting a time, because the flag held whatever the
    register carried and the refusal boxed as the integer -1;
  - `file_get_contents` answers elephc's STRING ABI, where php `false` is a null POINTER in a
    different register again.

Every failure value was read from the helper's own failure path rather than assumed, because they
are not uniform: 0 for the predicates, -1 for `opendir` and `file_put_contents`, -2 for `readfile`,
a null listing pointer for `scandir` and `file`.

Verified: `cargo test -p elephc --lib` 1 530 passed, `codegen_tests io::` 1 026 passed.
EOF
